slices.title: Docked trays
slices.summary: Adds a composer-docked tray host that shows one pending item at a time by priority (approval, question, plan, queue) above the composer, reusing the existing ApprovalRequests, PlanApprovalControl and QueuedInputStrip components and moving their mounts out of the transcript. Pure front-end layout change with no contract and no flag; a pending approval or plan leaves a one-line pointer in the transcript while the tray holds the control.

slices.title: Plan approve-then-execute
slices.summary: Plan approval starts a new Do run on the same thread: the gateway binds the thread's durable grant to the new run server-side (BindGrantToRun on WS04's ThreadAutonomy, plan id must match, single-use CAS, no client-supplied rung) and the SPA sends one execute turn carrying approved_plan_id, behind MODEL_GATEWAY_PLAN_EXECUTE_ON_APPROVE (default off, where next_message keeps today's behaviour). Authority narrows, never widens, for a run in flight.
slices.needs_external: DEC-04 recorded by the owner (OD6) before merge; WS04-S4 durable thread grant (not built; flag MODEL_GATEWAY_DURABLE_PLAN_GRANT); WS02-S6 composer edits to sse.rs first; WS01-S0 live ZDR wave; DEC-39 integrator-assigned proto numbers.

slices.title: Same-run resume delivery
slices.summary: Lets an answer continue the same run: a question pauses the run as awaiting_input (PendingPause kind input), /continue applies the answer as the tool result or as the stage-1 brief, and a single-use consume step stops double answers; behind AGENT_ASK_USER_RESUME_ENABLED (default false) on top of the WS03 switches.
